svg.text: Observed lane ordering across shallow and deep workload profiles
Same Quark target and TP=2/BF16 KV, but context, concurrency, turn counts and pool differ. Each profile is normalised to its own non-spec wall time.
At 16K, MTP wall is 12.4% lower — inside the ≈15% repeat-spread floor. At deep load it is 68.2% higher.
These observations do not isolate depth or reproduce the project benchmark. Literal 8K overflowed; DFlash2 repro arms were cancelled.
Compare within-profile ordering cautiously; do not compare raw wall times as equivalent work.
